items.title: From problem to fix in minutes: Automating search relevance tuning with the Amazon OpenSearch Search Relevance Agent
items.summary: The Amazon OpenSearch Service Search Relevance Agent automates search relevance tuning. You describe a problem in plain language, and the agent investigates your behavioral data, proposes an improved query, and validates it with an offline experiment. This post walks through the agent's architecture and a complete example investigation.
items.creator: Aruna Govindaraju
